name: commdgi
reference: Zhang, Hu, He, Wang. CommDGI: Community Detection Oriented Deep Graph Infomax. CIKM 2020.

upstream.note: The Encoder/Summarizer/corruption/cluster_net (model.py) and DeepGraphInfomax (DGI.py) are imported unchanged; the patch is two compat fixes (networkx from_numpy_array, sklearn multi_class) off our driver's path. Training is run_commdgi.py on the shared harness, not the authors' train.py.

hidden.doc: Embedding dimensionality of the DGI encoder. Default 64 (paper's standard, §4.3). The paper's primary sensitivity sweep is over {8,16,32,64,128} (Fig 4), so it is tunable.

feature_kind.doc: Synthetic node representation used only when the instance has no real features.

learning_rate.doc: Adam learning rate. Fixed at 1e-3 in the paper (§4.3); never swept, so set-only.

clustertemp.doc: Clustering softmax temperature delta. Fixed at 30 in the paper (§4.3); never swept, so set-only.

weight_decay.doc: Adam weight decay. Paper (§4.3) uses 0.2; the repo hardcoded 0.005. Never swept, so set-only.

graph_weight.doc: Weight alpha on the DGI/graph mutual-information loss (Eq. 9, paper value 2). Swept in Figs 6/7; tunable.

community_weight.doc: Weight beta on the community mutual-information loss (Eq. 9, paper value 5; §4.6 says community MI should carry the largest weight). Swept in Figs 6/7; tunable.

sparse_modularity.doc: Protocol B: compute the modularity term from the sparse adjacency instead of the authors' dense n x n matrix (numerically equivalent, but O(n) memory). Off keeps Protocol A faithful to the reference code.
